Everyone who is clean in your house may eat it," whereas the verse as cited (Num 18:11) reads: "This also is yours: the heave offering of their gift, with all the wave offerings of the children of Israel; I have given them to you, and your sons and daughters with you, as an ordinance forever. Everyone who is clean in your house may eat it."

content.hebrew: בספר גן עדן כתוב:  והקריב אותם לאשם ואת לוג השמן והניף אותם תנופה לפני ה'" והפסוק המצוטט מספר ויקרא י"ד, 12, כתוב:  "הִקְרִיב אֹתוֹ לְאָשָׁם--וְאֶת-לֹג הַשָּׁמֶן; וְהֵנִיף אֹתָם תְּנוּפָה, לִפְנֵי ה'".
content.english: In *Gan Eden* it is written: "And he shall bring them as a trespass offering and the log of oil, and wave them as a wave offering before the LORD," whereas the verse as cited (Lev 14:12) reads: "He shall bring it as a trespass offering, along with the log of oil, and wave them as a wave offering before the LORD."

content.hebrew: בספר גן עדן כתוב:  "חלה תרימו תרומה לה' כתרומת גורן" והפסוק המצוטט מספר במדבר ט"ו, 20, כתוב:  "חַלָּה, תָּרִימוּ תְרוּמָה: כִּתְרוּמַת גֹּרֶן".
content.english: In *Gan Eden* it is written: "You shall offer up a cake as a heave offering to the LORD, like the heave offering of the threshing floor," whereas the verse as cited (Num 15:20) reads: "You shall offer up a cake as a heave offering; as a heave offering of the threshing floor."

content.hebrew: בספר גן עדן כתוב:  "ואם אין לאיש גואל להשיב האשם אליו האשם המושב לה' לכהן אשר יכפר בו לו יהיה" והפסוק המצוטט מספר במדבר ה, 8, כתוב:  "וְאִם-אֵין לָאִישׁ גֹּאֵל, לְהָשִׁיב הָאָשָׁם אֵלָיו--הָאָשָׁם הַמּוּשָׁב לַה', לַכֹּהֵן:  מִלְּבַד, אֵיל הַכִּפֻּרִים, אֲשֶׁר יְכַפֶּר-בּוֹ, עָלָיו".
content.english: In *Gan Eden* it is written: "But if the man has no kinsman to whom restitution may be made for the wrong, the restitution which is made for the wrong must go to the LORD for the priest, besides it shall be his," whereas the verse as cited (Num 5:8) reads: "But if the man has no relative to whom restitution may be made for the wrong, the restitution for the wrong must go to the LORD for the priest, besides the ram of the atonement with which atonement is made for him."

content.hebrew: בספר גן עדן כתוב:  "לא תוכל בשעריך מעשר דגנך תירושך ויצהרך ובכורות בקרך וצאנך ותרומת ידך" והפסוק המצוטט מספר דברים י"ב, 17, כתוב:  "לֹא-תוּכַל לֶאֱכֹל בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ, מַעְשַׂר דְּגָנְךָ וְתִירֹשְׁךָ וְיִצְהָרֶךָ, וּבְכֹרֹת בְּקָרְךָ, וְצֹאנֶךָ; וְכָל-נְדָרֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר תִּדֹּר, וְנִדְבֹתֶיךָ וּתְרוּמַת יָדֶךָ".
content.english: In *Gan Eden* it is written: "You are not able in your gates the tithe of your grain or your new wine or your oil, or the firstborn of your herd or your flock, or the heave offering of your hand," whereas the verse as cited (Deut 12:17) reads: "You may not eat within your gates the tithe of your grain or your new wine or your oil, of the firstborn of your herd or your flock, of any of your offerings which you vow, of your freewill offerings, or of the heave offering of your hand."

content.hebrew: בספר גן עדן כתוב:  "ובקצרכם את קציר ארצכם לא תכלה פאת שדך בקצרך ולקט קצירך לא תלקט לעני ולגר תעזוב אותם" והפסוקים המצוטטים מספר ויקרא י"ט, 10-9, כתוב:  " וּבְקֻצְרְכֶם אֶת-קְצִיר אַרְצְכֶם, לֹא תְכַלֶּה פְּאַת שָׂדְךָ לִקְצֹר; וְלֶקֶט קְצִירְךָ, לֹא תְלַקֵּט. וְכַרְמְךָ לֹא תְעוֹלֵל, וּפֶרֶט כַּרְמְךָ לֹא תְלַקֵּט: לֶעָנִי וְלַגֵּר תַּעֲזֹב אֹתָם".
content.english: In *Gan Eden* it is written: "When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not wholly reap the corners of your field, nor shall you gather the gleanings of your harvest. You shall leave them for the poor and for the stranger," and the verses quoted from Lev 19:9-10 state: "When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not wholly reap the corners of your field, nor shall you gather the gleanings of your harvest. And you shall not glean your vineyard, nor shall you gather every grape of your vineyard; you shall leave them for the poor and for the stranger."

content.hebrew: בספר גן עדן כתוב:  "ולבני לוי נתתי", והפסוק המצוטט במספר במדבר י"ח, 20, כתוב:  "וְלִבְנֵי לֵוִי, הִנֵּה נָתַתִּי".
content.english: In *Gan Eden* it is written: "And to the children of Levi I have given," and the verse quoted in Num 18:20 states: "And to the children of Levi, behold, I have given."
